SELECT tblHotDealPost.*, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_id AS seq, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_title AS subject, (SELECT username FROM tblUser WHERE user_id = tblHotDealPost.user_id) AS id, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_regdate AS regdate, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_content AS content, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_name AS itemName, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_price AS price, tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_url AS url, (SELECT nickname FROM tblUser WHERE user_id = tblHotDealPost.user_id) AS name, (SELECT hotdeal_image_url FROM tblHotDealImage WHERE hotdeal_id = tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_id AND ROWNUM = 1) AS img, (SELECT hotdeal_category FROM tblHotDealCategory WHERE hotdeal_category_id = tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_category_id) AS category, (SELECT hotdeal_status FROM tblHotDealStatus WHERE hotdeal_status_id = tblHotDealPost.hotdeal_status_id) AS status FROM tblHotDealPost WHERE hotdeal_id = #{seq}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT vw_hotdeal_comment.*, vw_hotdeal_comment.user_id as useq, vw_hotdeal_comment.hotdeal_id as bseq, vw_hotdeal_comment.user_login as id, vw_hotdeal_comment.hotdeal_comment_id as seq, (SELECT nickname FROM tblUser WHERE user_id = vw_hotdeal_comment.user_id) AS name FROM vw_hotdeal_comment WHERE hotdeal_id = #{bseq} ORDER BY hotdeal_comment_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

mapper.select: SELECT hotdeal_comment_id AS seq, hotdeal_id AS bseq, user_id AS useq, hotdeal_comment_content AS content, hotdeal_comment_regdate AS regdate, (SELECT username FROM tblUser WHERE user_id = tblHotDealComment.user_id) AS id, (SELECT nickname FROM tblUser WHERE user_id = tblHotDealComment.user_id) AS name FROM tblHotDealComment WHERE hotdeal_comment_id = #{param1, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, T1.* FROM ( SELECT c.hotdeal_comment_id AS seq, c.hotdeal_comment_content AS content, c.user_id AS id, TO_CHAR(c.hotdeal_comment_regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regdate, c.hotdeal_id AS bseq, u.nickname AS name FROM tblHotDealComment c LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.hotdeal_id = #{bseq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY c.hotdeal_comment_id DESC ) T1 ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{begin, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND #{begin, jdbcType=INTEGER} + 4
mapper.insert: insert into tblHotDealPost (hotdeal_id, user_id, hotdeal_category_id, hotdeal_status_id, hotdeal_title, hotdeal_content, hotdeal_name, hotdeal_price, hotdeal_url, hotdeal_view_count, hotdeal_report_count, hotdeal_report_status, hotdeal_regdate) values (seqHotDealPost.nextVal,#{useq} ,#{category}, #{status}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{itemName},#{price} ,#{url} ,#{useq}, 0, 'N', sysdate)
INSERT INTO tblHotDealImage (hotdeal_image_id, hotdeal_id, hotdeal_image_url, hotdeal_image_seq) VALUES (seqHotDealImage.nextVal, #{hotdealId}, #{img}, #{hotdealImageSeq})
mapper.select: SELECT hotdeal_image_id as hotdealImageId, hotdeal_id as hotdealId, hotdeal_image_url as hotdealImageUrl, hotdeal_image_seq as hotdealImageSeq FROM tblHotDealImage WHERE hotdeal_id = #{seq} ORDER BY hotdeal_image_seq
